legend.0: 0 — invisible: no README, or the README does not explain what it is.
legend.1: 1 — described: a README explains it, but there is nothing to run.
legend.2: 2 — runnable: a stranger can execute something in under 10 minutes.
legend.3: 3 — verifiable: runnable, with a machine-checkable receipt or test suite a stranger can independently confirm.
legend.4: 4 — composable: an outside agent can depend on it through a stable interface and get a receipt back.
